title: A large Fourier coefficient for sign-valued functions
statement: Let $n$ be even, and let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $|f(x)|=1$ for every $x$. Then some Fourier coefficient of $f$ on the binary cube has absolute value at least $2^{-n/2}$.
